3rd straight following an 8-game skid</title><link>http://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=401910031</link><description>— Kyshawn George scored 24 points and Anthony Davis added 22 to lead the Washington Wizards to their third straight victory, 116-96 over the Orlando Magic on Sunday night.</description><pubDate>Mon, 23 Nov 2026 02:33:32 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://s.espncdn.com/stitcher/sports/basketball/nba/events/401910031.png?templateId=espn.applewatch.awayhome.1" /></item><item><title>Bam Adebayo's triple-double ignites Heat's 123-113 victory over Thunder</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50568682/adebayo-triple-double-sparks-shorthanded-heat-victory</link><description>In a game that did not feature Oklahoma City's Shai Gilgeous-Alexander or Miami's Giannis Antetokounmpo, Bam Adebayo swiped the spotlight, scoring 24 points en route to a triple-double, as the surging Heat defeated the Thunder 123-113 on Sunday night.</description><pubDate>Mon, 23 Nov 2026 02:14:33 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1123/r1749970_600x600_1-1.jpg" /></item><item><title>Adebayo gets triple-double, Heat (without Giannis) top Thunder (without SGA) for 7th straight win</title><link>http://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=401910030</link><description>— Bam Adebayo scored 24 points and had a triple-double, Pelle Larsson scored 21 and the shorthanded Miami Heat beat the very shorthanded Oklahoma City Thunder 123-113 on Sunday night to push their winning streak to seven games.</description><pubDate>Mon, 23 Nov 2026 01:42:41 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://s.espncdn.com/stitcher/sports/basketball/nba/events/401910030.png?templateId=espn.applewatch.awayhome.1" Cunningham</title><link>http://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=401910029</link><description>— Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored 27 points, Atlanta opened the fourth quarter with an 18-0 run, and the Hawks
